description: Single source of truth for the kit's MCP servers (kit ADR-0006 §4). scripts/gen-mcp.py projects it into per-plugin .mcp.json (Claude marketplace), a marker block in ~/.codex/config.toml, and the mcp key of ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json. The enabled flag is committed configuration, not runtime state — flip it and re-run the generator.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.notes: Official Google server. Front-end debugging: console, network, performance traces, DOM — pairs with the frontend-nuxt rule's hydration/SSR pitfalls. Runs headless + isolated, pinned to the system Chromium via --executablePath. NOTE: /usr/lib/chromium/chromium is Linux/WSL-specific — public adopters on macOS or other distros must change or drop this path.

servers.name: context7
servers.notes: Live version-pinned library docs; no CLI equivalent. Used by dev-stack-guide and framework work.

servers.name: playwright
servers.notes: Official Microsoft server. Verifies com-slide-deck / com-artefact-viz HTML output. Demotion candidate if browser-server overlap with chrome-devtools ever bites.

servers.name: github
servers.notes: Opt-in: gh CLI covers ~90% (CLI-first, ADR-0006). Enable for sessions without gh auth or structured PR-review flows.

servers.name: terraform
servers.notes: Official HashiCorp server. Opt-in: single-skill use (ops-terraform-exoscale provider-docs lookup).

postgresql.why_not_user_global: Databases are per-project (ADR-0006): declare in the project's own .mcp.json / opencode.json when it makes sense. Codex caveat: config.toml is global-only — enable there deliberately.
postgresql.context: Anthropic's reference server was archived July 2025 (SQLi); PGDG ships none — revisit if an official server appears.
